text: Just as I am thinking about my schedule for the day, my phone vibrates and a message from the Mahjong group chat pops up.
Furikomi Master

{character: Furikomi Master} Big news! Big news!!! The air conditioning in the dojo is busted, and it's gonna take a full week to repair it. It's hotter than an oven in there, so definitely don't come here! Boy, I sure took one for the team there, didn't I?!

"Furikomi Master" is the most active admin of the Mahjong group chat. And the dojo he mentioned is the one I frequent, the Aqua Dojo. But playing Mahjong in a dojo without air conditioning, in this weather...? Maybe I should find something else to do.
Like... Checking in on A-37? The idea pops into my head when my gaze falls upon some coupons on the coffee table.

A-37's been working part-time at that café near Central Park that went viral—"Éternité"—and brought a few coupons back yesterday. He said they're holding a special summer promotion, and that I should swing by if I had time.
Well, no time like the present! Let's go check it out.
{character:???} Master... Master, this way, nyaa—
I look where the sound is coming from, only to see a hand waving frantically above the crowd. Occasionally, a little hop brings a pair of cat ears into view. Sure enough, it's Ichihime.
Ichihime
player
{character:player} Is Kaavi here too?
Reina Nanami

Reina Nanami half opens the door to the coffee shop, and cool air smelling sweetly of fresh coffee and cream hits my senses. I suppose I can see why Éternité has become so popular all of a sudden. In this sort of weather, who could possibly refuse a quality coffee shop offering not only special promotions, but also fully functioning air conditioning?

Inside, Éternité is not ostentatious at all, but decorated in a minimalist and comfortable modern style. The designers had made good use of plants and other furnishings to subtly divide the tables, offering customers a degree of privacy.
{character:player} This is...
{character:Ichihime} Master successfully captured! Nyaa!
Several recent crime news flashes through my head as I assess the strength of the two girls in front of me... I must have misunderstood the situation...
{character:Reina Nanami} Don't be so nervous! We just want to see if you'd be willing to come and help out at the shop for a while? We'd pay you by the day, of course!
{character:player} But... Don't you have enough part-time workers already?
{character:Reina Nanami} Ahaha... Well, now you brought it up, that might just be one of the reasons why we are short of staff.
Reina fishes out her phone, opens the forum homepage, and hands it to me—The whole screen is filled with posts about Éternité.
{character:Ichihime} Seems Master has understood our current predicament! So quick, go get changed and help Ichihime make some money, nyaa!
{character:Reina Nanami} And don't worry about the size of the uniform. It's all adjustable within a certain range.
{character:Ichihime} Oooooh, Ichihime can't wait to see how Master looks in the uniform, nyaa!

Declining is clearly not an option... But, you know what? The dojo's air conditioning was going to take ages to fix anyway, so why don't I take this time and see what's like to work in a popular café?
15 minutes later
Check out the cat tree over in the corner
See what's behind the nearby plants
I decide to check out the cat tree in the corner. And when I get closer I realize A-37 is indeed there. He is squatting down and giving a few of the cats a thorough brushing.
I'd have to thread my way through the whole café to actually get to the cat tree. To avoid such hassle, I decide to go have a look behind the nearby plants.
Hinata Takanashi grabs me and gives me a good look-over to see if I'm alright, before heaving a sigh of relief.
I look up and see Ichihime running back and forth at the counter. Yep, I probably count as a qualified cat owner.

Although A-37 had spoken in all seriousness, it is hard to imagine how this adorable British Shorthair—perching on my knee and swishing its tail gently against my arm—can be the dangerous creature he described.

I look down and examine more carefully, only to find there really is a pattern of 6-Sou! A-37 hands me the nearby kitty claw clipper, and I carefully probe the cat's front paw. Sure enough, Sixsou doesn't resist.

Squeezing the soft little pad gently, I can see four potentially formidable claws already protruding. I quickly trim each of them in turn, after which Sixsou glances up at me with an expression that seems to signify satisfaction with my service.

I manage to finish the job quickly, thanks in no small part to Sixsou's cooperation. Looking up, I see A-37 busy trimming the claws of a corpulent tabby. Catching my eye, he starts to introduce the kitty to me without looking up.

Simples is nowhere near as cooperative as Sixsou. As A-37 touches its hind leg, I see Simples twist its head and looks like it's about to bite. But, upon discovering that the offending touch comes from A-37, the tabby seems to think better of it and shrinks back in fear. This happens several times, until A-37 completes the job.
I look at A-37, then at the cat next to me. Suddenly, a bold idea strikes me, and I poke A-37 in the leg. A-37 jerks, his whole body visibly tensing as he looks at me with a panicked expression.
A-37 must have seen me gearing up to poke him again, as he promptly gets up and scarpers.
Looking at his retreating back, I begin to see why I didn't find it weird to see him in the middle of a bunch of cats.

I look at the small white cat, Haku, lying by A-37's feet and stretching out its pink little paws to snag his clothes. A-37 bends down and picks it up in one hand before stroking its head and handing it to me.
I carefully place the cat—more of a kitten, really—on my lap. It has long white fur, but there are shades of gray on its ears and the tip of its tail.
A-37 calls its name in a soft voice, then extends a finger to rub its chin. In response, Haku delicately places its paw in the palm of his hand.
A-37 lowers his head to clip Haku's claws, while telling me its history. His tone may be calm, but the story he told was truly sad.

I remember that I don't actually know that much about A-37. Sometimes an individual's past or their mood is easily expressed in their words, just like A-37 right then. Thinking of this, I stroked the kitten's furry head and decided to tell him what I was thinking.
A-37 seems surprised to hear me say this. He looks up at me, his golden eyes showing a touch of confusion, before quickly giving me a pure, clear smile.
Chiori picks up a deck of cards from a neighboring table and hands it to me.
I look at the figures scurrying busily around me, and then at the card in my hand. So Éternité is actually this kind of café? Before I can really think about it, Chiori grabs me by my sleeve.
I carefully read the instructions on the card. It's just a simple fun game, nothing too technical. If it's just Chiori and myself, we should be able to solve the problem with rock, paper, scissors.
To avoid disturbing others, we decide to go to the staff lounge next door to practice Truth or Dare.
Choice: Rock / Scissors / Paper
{character:A-37} These are strays from the park next door. They got used to this place and just stuck around.
{character:player} Seems like something a kitty would do.
{character:A-37} Or, to put it another way: It's better to use its own strengths to fill its stomach, rather than relying on the pity of humans.
{character:A-37} The manager just told me that from today you'll be helping out around here, so let me show you around.
{character:player} Is that not something the manager should do?
{character:A-37} ...Well, more of a bodyguard's job, really. In a coffee shop like this, there are always accidents waiting to happen, so I'd prefer to show you around myself.
{character:player} Accidents...?
{character:A-37} Oh, bits of broken glass hidden in the carpet, sharp tray edges just waiting to open your finger, drinks with who-knows-what additives, and—
{character:???} Argh! Watch out!
{character:A-37} Omelet rice that suddenly attacks...
{character:Hinata Takanashi} Oh my, I'm sorry! So sorry! I slipped.
{character:Hinata Takanashi} Thank goodness we have Mr. A with us today, heehee... Otherwise there'd be trouble again.
{character:Customer A} Haha! It appears Ms. Hinata's a little distracted today, as usual!
{character:player} Isn't the staff lounge over there...?
{character:player} Hahaha! I can't believe I never realized how clumsy she can be.

{character:A-37} That's probably because you mostly know her from the Mahjong table! Takanashi is a lot more aggressive and focused there than in normal life, so it can be hard to spot her clumsy nature.
{character:player} Is this really part of the job?
{character:A-37} Well, seeing as we've decided to keep them around as a bit of an attraction, we have to consider all sorts of things, including hygiene.
I've clipped cat claws before
I've never clipped cat claws before
Hinata Takanashi
Customer A
Customer B
{character:Customer B} You can do it, Ms. Takanashi, Queen of Clumsy! Don't mess up!
{character:player} No problem, let me handle it. After all, I'm kind of a pro cat owner myself, you know?

{character:A-37} No need to worry. Whether it's looking after new staff, or making sure you're safe, I'm always around to help you... After all, these little guys were famous Central Park "bullies" before they came here.
{character:A-37} Sixsou is the gentlest one we have... Well, by "gentle" I mean "lazy when there's no danger", so it's best to start from it.
{character:A-37} Doesn't the stripy pattern on its back look a lot like the 6-Sou tile?
{character:player} Why is it called Sixsou?
{character:A-37} This is Simples. The priestess chose the name, saying that it would bring us luck.
{character:player} I had no idea you had this sort of power over kitties! That was so cute, seeing how it wanted to bite but did not dare to.
{character:A-37} Most cats don't like people touching their back legs.
{character:A-37} It seems you're already familiar with most of our kitty assistants, so I'll leave you to it.
Right when we are about to get back to the training, there is a knock at the door, and Reina Nanami comes in.
Reina and I glance at each other. Although Chiori seems angry, that seems to be what happened! Despite the misunderstanding, thanks to Riu I still had a busy and enjoyable afternoon.

Before I know it, the day is over. Even though my aching muscles are a constant reminder that I'd actually done a lot today, I am really happy. I forget who it was that said: Working is a pleasure, if you're working with those you like.
Choice: Truth / Dare
A random card is pulled from the "Truth" deck, which reads: When you are playing Mahjong with friends, would you discard tiles they need intentionally to make them happy?
Isn't that a bit too sensitive for an opening question?! But I think if it were me...
Choice: Yes / No
A random card is pulled from the "Dare" deck, which reads: Leave your current location and pat the first person you encounter on the head three times.
I reluctantly leave the gloating Chiori and push open the door, only to bump into Momo Hina!

I reach out and gently pat Momo on the head three times. Her hair is as soft and fluffy as her personality. But unfortunately, she wasn't able to join in our game and quickly returns to her busy work.
I look at myself and Chiori and all I can see are two really lazy workers... Never mind, it's better to be properly trained first before starting to work anyway.
I take a card fallen beside the stack Chiori pointed at and handed it to her.
Chiori leans over, staring at me with wide eyes, and starts counting down in a whisper: "30... 29... 28..."
However, to my surprise, after just ten seconds, her eyes are already turning red! That, coupled with the bow on her hair, makes her seem like a little rabbit.
With less than half the time left, she gives up unwillingly.
A random card is pulled from the "Truth" deck, which read: Would you choose the one in front of you if you need a teammate in a survival game?
Is this Truth or Dare or Truth or Death?! There's no good answer!
A random card is pulled from the "Dare" deck, which read: Imitate a cat's meow three times.
{character:Chiori Mikami} Nyaa... Nyaa... Nyaaaa!
I should call it a night and make sure I'm well-rested for tomorrow's work!
{character:player} I've never clipped a cat's claws before... What if I clipped the flesh by mistake?
{character:A-37} Then just hold them for me. If they get a bit agitated, just give them a stroke, like this.
{character:A-37} Haku.
{character:A-37} I rescued Haku last month, while on my way to work. I saw its mother and two other kittens were already gone, so I took Haku with me.
{character:player} It's so small!
{character:player} To be honest, I'm really happy you're staying in my loft, because I like having you around. It would be great if you could stay forever!
{character:A-37} Yeah, that would be wonderful.
{character:Chiori Mikami} Oh, it's you. Hmph. Judging by your clothes, you must be working part-time here too.
{character:player} Not what I came here to do, but you're not wrong. How come you're here alone?
{character:Chiori Mikami} Hmph, it's all because of this.
{character:player} Truth or Dare?

{character:Chiori Mikami} Riu said this was a necessary skill for working part-time in a café! I... Hmph, of course I know how to play this. It's just that I need to make sure I can definitively win every time before playing with unfamiliar peasants.
{character:Chiori Mikami} Peasant, I'll give you the honor you are to play with me! I assume you know the rules, hmm?
{character:player} I think so. Let's do Rock, Paper, Scissors, whoever loses has to choose either Truth or Dare as punishment. Then just draw a card and do what it says.
{character:Chiori Mikami} Huh? Rock, Paper, Scissors? Pff, whatever... That's fine. My fantastic luck should hold.
{character:Chiori Mikami} Let the first round begin! Are you ready? Rock, paper, scissors—
Choose Rock
Choose Scissors
Choose Paper
Chiori Mikami
{character:Chiori Mikami} Damn peasant! I can't believe you predicted my move... So be it. Now what?
{character:player} Well then, if you would be so kind as to draw either a Truth or a Dare card.
{character:Chiori Mikami} Um... Ok... Well, how about this Truth card? No peeking!
{character:Chiori Mikami} Who... Do you want to... Go to an onsen with the most?
{character:player} Well, who would it be?

{character:Chiori Mikami} What a nonsense question! Of course it's Riu! How could one such as I go with a mere peasant...? Although you know, I do actually have a plan to go to an onsen with Riu... Seeing as how helpful you've been today, it's not outside the realms of possibility that you could perhaps come along. But, obviously you'd have to find your OWN spring to soak in!
{character:Chiori Mikami} Aha! Did I not say that my luck is impeccable?! Still wanna trump me in this trifling game, you peasant? Come now, choose your punishment!
Choose Truth
Choose Dare
{character:Chiori Mikami} It appears to be a tie. So what now, peasant?
{character:player} Well, no one lost and no one won. Let's just play another round.
{character:player} I'll take a Truth.
Yes
No
{character:player} I'll take a Dare.
{character:Chiori Mikami} Ahaha! What sort of monstrous punishment is this?! Listen, peasant. If you run into danger, I shall allow you to seek my assistance.
{character:Momo Hina} Eh?! Mr... Mr. Rabbit?
{character:player} Are you here to take a break, Momo?
{character:Momo Hina} No. I just heard people talking when passing by and wanted to see what was up... Eh, are Mr. Rabbit and Chiori having a bunny family party?
{character:player} We are just doing some Truth and Dare practice.
{character:Momo Hina} Ehh... I'd like to play, too.
{character:player} Of course! But, er, before you do... Could you let me pat your head three times?
{character:Momo Hina} I don't know why would you want to do that, but anything for Mr. Rabbit!
Momo Hina
{character:Chiori Mikami} Who would have thought that you are actually quite selfless, peasant. But fear not! Should you ever have the honor of playing with me, such a situation will never arise.
{character:player} I wouldn't. All's fair in love and Mahjong, and anyway... Isn't seeing them cry when they're totally beaten the best part about playing with friends?

{character:Chiori Mikami} Who would have thought that you have such a side to you, peasant! In that case... There's no way I'll go easy on you when next we play together. Hmph... Just you wait and see!
{character:Chiori Mikami} Come on, get ready! Second round! Three, two, one, rock, paper, scissors—
{character:Chiori Mikami} A tie, peasant.
{character:player} Let's go again then.
{character:Chiori Mikami} How can this be?! How did I lose a guessing game to a mere peasant?!
{character:player} Come along, Chiori. Your punishment awaits!
{character:Chiori Mikami} Darn it. Fine. Dare, then. Yes, that card. Give it here!
{character:Chiori Mikami} Choose a person and stare into their eyes for 30 seconds without blinking... Pff, what sort of challenge is that?
{character:Chiori Mikami} What sort of devilish punishment is this? Humans aren't built to stare for 30 seconds without blinking! My eyes hurt so much... *sobs*
{character:Chiori Mikami} Peasant, it's your turn to take punishment. I'm watching you!
{character:player} ...
{character:player} Nyaa-nyaa-nyaa.
{character:player} Nyaa... Nyaa... Nyaaaa!
{character:Chiori Mikami} Come on, don't be a bad sport!
{character:Chiori Mikami} What's the matter? You've known Ichihime for ages. How come you still don't know how to say nyaa? Alright, now say it after me...
{character:Chiori Mikami} Hmm, I suppose that counts.
{character:player} I would. I trust Chiori to get us out of there, because she's so smart.
{character:Chiori Mikami} I suppose you know what's what, peasant! Worry not, should the end of the world truly come, I will be able to protect you.
{character:player} Uh... No?
{character:Chiori Mikami} Peasant! You're lucky I'm giving you another minute to reconsider your answer!
{character:player} Think about it—if we're really facing the end of the world, do you really think that the two of us could survive if stuck with each other?
{character:Chiori Mikami} Well... That's not totally irrational. In that case, we should go on our own merry way now, right? Better to split up now than perish together!
{character:player} There's no need to be so hasty! I think we'd still have some fight in us. We can use our brains, after all.
{character:Reina Nanami} Gotcha, you layabouts!
{character:player} Let me explain! We're just training.
{character:Reina Nanami} Training?
{character:Chiori Mikami} Yes... When I got here this morning, Riu gave me this and the uniform, saying that it's a must-have skill that I have to learn.

{character:Reina Nanami} Truth or Dare...? Hmm, Ms. Kujou might have gotten the wrong end of the stick when she saw Chiori's maid-style uniform. Éternité is just an ordinary café! However, it's not a terrible idea to occasionally offer this sort of fun game!
{character:Chiori Mikami} Wait, so you're saying that... My training was for nothing?!
Despite the inclement weather today, there are still loads of customers waiting. Parasols have also been put up by the entrance to increase the amount of outdoor seating.

After confirming Ichihime's location, I thread my way through the crowd to arrive at her side. And to my surprise, Éternité has even recruited the priestess from Mahjong Soul Shrine to work here part-time!
{character:Reina Nanami} Ms. Kaavi had a coffee here an hour or so ago, but she has already left. It's so hot outside, why don't you come inside, {var:player_nickname}?
I change my clothes and leave the staff lounge, only to see Reina and Ichihime already busy at work. Maybe it'd be better to find someone else to show me the ropes.
Looking around, I thought I saw A-37 over by a cat tree in the corner, while a familiar voice came from behind some nearby plants. It seemed to be that of Chiori Mikami...
{character:player} I remember Reina saying in CatChat that she wanted to pick up some rabbits. How come that's changed to cats?
{character:Chiori Mikami} That's my wisdom, What's it to you, peasant?! Hmph!
#éternité Pretty catgirl waitress here!!//n#éternité That waiter is so hot, anyone knows if he's taken????//n......
"WarOfMaid"?! Although I seem to see some familiar IDs among those posts, I instantly understand what Reina meant. In a sense, it actually shows that Éternité has quite a high service standard.
{character:Ichihime} Kaavi's predictions are really spot on! She said that Master would come today, and she was right, nyaa!
However, instead of taking me to a seat, Ichihime and Reina drag me all the way to the staff rest area. As soon as I walk in, I hear a click as the door locks behind me.
{character:A-37} Even though they've decided to stay here, they have to prove their worth. If they want free cat food, they need to learn how to please the customers.
{character:player} You make the fun cats and humans have with each other sound coldly transactional...

A-37's little white cat seems to understand him, nyaaing and rubbing against his hand a few times. If I haven't witnessed it with my own eyes, I'd never have believed that A-37, who's usually so distant and aloof, would one day not only be surrounded by cats but also seem to be having fun in their midst!
A sudden shout interrupts A-37. I look toward the noise and see some flying object heading towards me at high speed... before being caught by the agile A-37.
A-37 calmly picks up where he'd left off. I look and, sure enough, he is holding a dish of omelet rice. The omelet seems to have been torn up a bit, most likely by the violent shaking just now.

The sound of banter came from customers at a nearby table, who seemed pretty familiar with the staff. Hinata greets them pleasantly, then takes the omelet rice from A-37 and hurries back to the kitchen. However...
Sure enough, before you know it Hinata has already rushed back out, hurrying in another direction.
{character:A-37} Alright, now come over and we can get started. So, have you ever clipped a cat's claws?
{character:Reina Nanami} Save us, {var:player_nickname}!
{character:player} I would. Playing with friends is meant to be fun, right? If losing a few points can make everyone have a good time, then it's definitely worth it.
{character:A-37} I don't know how old it actually is, but judging by the size, it can't be more than half a year old. Anyways, it has a home now.
I walk over to find that it's indeed Chiori Mikami. She seems to be on the phone discussing something, stone-faced, but she hangs up after seeing me.
